rounds.text: Winny Immigration & Education Services Ltd is currently experiencing a severe and accelerating deterioration of its core business operations. The company’s compounded sales growth has plummeted by 73% over the trailing twelve months [E15], while its operating margin has collapsed to -574% in the most recent quarter [E21]. This downward trend is persistent, with yearly operating margins decreasing consistently over the last four years [E22]. The financial health of the firm is further compromised by negative cash flows, with operating cash flow at Rs -4.83 Cr and free cash flow at Rs -5.02 Cr as of March 2026 [E25, E26]. Consequently, the company has been forced to increase its borrowings to Rs 4.10 Cr, a significant jump from just Rs 0.27 Cr the previous year [E28]. The market has reacted to these fundamental failures with a 68.8% decline in share price over the last twelve months, leaving the stock trading near its 52-week low [E34, E37, E49]. Conceded: the company has completed its capital expenditure as indicated by the reduction in capital work in progress [E29], and it maintains a high return on equity figure [E8].
